[[The Adjudicator]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[Recurve Bow]] dropped by [[White Mantle Seeker]]s and [[White Mantle Scout|Scouts]] in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:Damage +15% (while Health is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33% (stacking)
:Marksmanship +1 (20% chance while using skills)

==Skin==
This bow uses the same shape as a [[Hornbow (Mursaat)|Hornbow]] with the [[Mursaat]] skin, but it has a non-replicable coloring.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following:
**[[Ascalon Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[Bariel Darkroot]] or [[John Verado]]
**[[Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Dye Master Franjek]]
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[Dayoesh]], [[Pathfinder Mia]], or [[Cait]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
*[[Poisonous]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Attribute|of Marksmanship]]
OR
*One of the following [[recurve bow]]s:
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
